definitions.explanation: A Japanese banknote with a face value of 1,000 yen. One of the most commonly used denominations in daily transactions.

examples.japanese: {千円札|せんえんさつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}った→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: I paid with a thousand-yen bill.

examples.japanese: {千円札|せんえんさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{小銭|こぜに}→小銭：02759_kozeni⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{崩|くず}して→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please break this thousand-yen bill into coins.

examples.japanese: ⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{千円札|せんえんさつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{三枚|さんまい}しか⟦{残|のこ}っていなかった→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: There were only three thousand-yen bills left in my wallet.

notes:
The {千円札|せんえんさつ} is the most frequently used paper currency denomination in Japan for everyday purchases.

JAPANESE BANKNOTE DENOMINATIONS:
- {千円札|せんえんさつ}: 1,000-yen bill
- ⟦{五千円札|ごせんえんさつ}→五千円札：26561_gosenensatsu⟧: 5,000-yen bill
- ⟦{一万円札|いちまんえんさつ}→一万円札：26562_ichimanensatsu⟧: 10,000-yen bill

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {千円札|せんえんさつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay with a 1,000-yen bill
- {千円札|せんえんさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}す→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧: to break a 1,000-yen bill into coins
- ⟦お{札|さつ}→お札：19147_osatsu⟧: bill/banknote (general term)

COUNTER:
Bills are counted with ⟦{枚|まい}→〜枚：00650_mai⟧: {千円札|せんえんさつ}{三枚|さんまい} (three 1,000-yen bills).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{紙幣|しへい}→紙幣：00363_shihei⟧: paper currency, banknote (formal)
- ⟦{硬貨|こうか}→硬貨：02745_kouka⟧: coin
- ⟦{小銭|こぜに}→小銭：02759_kozeni⟧: small change
